name: Signal-transmission qualifier
summary: A transmission qualifier identifies the sending role of a signal interface.
description: A transmission qualifier identifies the sending role of a signal interface. Transmission identifies the source role of a signal relationship. It can be used beside a transducer, communications interface or other function whose output is conveyed elsewhere.
Identify the receiving function through a tag or cross-reference. Signal units and electrical interface details belong in the associated I/O or communications schedule.
readingNotes: Label the signal and the connected receiving function.
A transmitter-role indication does not identify the physical medium or electrical levels.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Label the signal and the connected receiving function.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A transmitter-role indication does not identify the physical medium or electrical levels.
